title: Ryusei Species Unistall
description: it'll remove all scoreboard and teams of Ryusei Species and all features of Ryusei Species datapack will be disappear if you install this plugin.
body:
It'll unistall all things from Ryusei's Species like teams and scoreboard.
So if you play with my Ryusei Species datapack for a long time and were bored with it, you can use this datapack to install my Ryusei Species clearly and tidy.
*Sorry for this inconvenient, I can't make an unistall feature in Ryusei Species because I was too lazy.
